_tuning_notes: Spawn rarity presets, calibrated against vanilla's own jungle pool (parrot 40 / chicken 10 / ocelot 2 / panda 1). A species picks ONE tier name and inherits weight + group size + nearby_cap; explicit weight/group_size/nearby_cap in a species file still win. nearby_cap is the accumulation killer: CREATURE-category animals never despawn, so without a cap a modest weight piles up forever (this is how gorillas reached ~30x panda density). attempt_chance thins epic tiers further — only that fraction of otherwise-valid spawn attempts survive. Hot-reloadable: edit + /reload and density changes with no rebuild.
